newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India GDRs fall in sluggish trade.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India GDRs fall in sluggish trade.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts fell back Friday in sluggish trading, dealers said, with investors' attention held by other Eastern markets.
"With the Hongkong handover and Thailand's devaluation people haven't had much time for India," said one trader.
But with a fresh 33-month high established in Bombay this week, traders say they are looking to firming GDRs.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 1.17 points lower at 88.59, down 1.30 percent, with the premium over the local market at 22.21 percent from 24.09.
Bombay's benchmark index rose 0.36 points to 4,323.82.
Hindalco lost $1.25 to $35.25/$36.25 and Bajaj Auto lost 12 cents to $34.00/$35.50.
The HSBC James Capel Korea GDR Index closed 0.31 points higher, or 0.39 percent, at 79.05 points, a premium of 40.95 percent over the local market.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index finished 3.13 points lower at 125.20, representing a discount to the local market of 1.72 percent.
